LIMIT_BAL.description: Amount of given credit in New Taiwan dollars (NT$), including individual and family/supplementary credit.

AGE.description: Age of the cardholder in years.

PAY_0.description: Repayment status in September 2005 (most recent month).
PAY_0.scale: -2=No consumption/balance, -1=Paid in full, 0=Revolving credit used (min payment), 1=Delay 1 month, 2=Delay 2 months, ..., 8=Delay 8 months, 9=Delay 9+ months

BILL_AMT1.description: Amount of bill statement in September 2005 (NT$).

BILL_AMT2.description: Amount of bill statement in August 2005 (NT$).

BILL_AMT3.description: Amount of bill statement in July 2005 (NT$).

BILL_AMT4.description: Amount of bill statement in June 2005 (NT$).

BILL_AMT5.description: Amount of bill statement in May 2005 (NT$).

BILL_AMT6.description: Amount of bill statement in April 2005 (NT$).

PAY_AMT1.description: Amount paid in September 2005 (towards August statement) in NT$.

PAY_AMT2.description: Amount paid in August 2005 (towards July statement) in NT$.

PAY_AMT3.description: Amount paid in July 2005 (towards June statement) in NT$.

PAY_AMT4.description: Amount paid in June 2005 (towards May statement) in NT$.

PAY_AMT5.description: Amount paid in May 2005 (towards April statement) in NT$.

PAY_AMT6.description: Amount paid in April 2005 (towards March statement) in NT$.

default_payment_next_month.description: Binary target: Did the customer default on the next month's payment (October 2005)?
